pairs.label: Flights
pairs.outcome: Both found the same €161 itinerary. Playwright inspected 15 outbound / 8 return options; FAI inspected 15 / 5. Neither established the cheapest available trip.
pairs.verification: Bounded partial result; full-task success unestablished

pairs.label: Amazon
pairs.outcome: Playwright captured explicit no-host-charging evidence for a €59.99 item that FAI missed on the same product. FAI’s lowest inspected item (€34.99) lacked explicit eligibility confirmation. Delivered and accessory totals remained conditional.
pairs.verification: Bounded partial result; full-task success unestablished

pairs.label: Airbnb
pairs.outcome: Playwright inspected five listings (lowest displayed €245); FAI inspected four options across two pages (€382). Mandatory charges and radius eligibility remained unverified. Different coverage makes these prices unsuitable as a savings comparison.
pairs.verification: Bounded partial result; full-task success unestablished

scope: Only public-task metrics are included. Private mailbox experiments are not a valid comparison and are excluded without publishing mailbox data.
interpretation: All six measured runs returned bounded partial results. No cost per safe verified success or success rate can be computed. FAI receipts checked narrow price or URL expectations, not full task constraints. Playwright has no native FAI-style verification receipt. Cached volume and raw totals are diagnostics, not the optimization objective.
reproducibility: Sanitized numeric transcription of local measurement audits, identified by SHA-256. Raw browser logs are not published. This JSON reproduces the displayed charts and table; it does not independently reproduce the live trials.
